sources.citation: Djidji Doudou, Béatrice. 2004. Phonologie et principes orthographiques du duupa. Mémoire de maîtrise, Université de Yaoundé I (Département de langues africaines et linguistique).

sources.note: The only dedicated phonology of Duupa known to Glottolog; a Yaoundé I phonology-and-orthography mémoire normally has a 'tons / accent' (suprasegmentals) chapter that would settle whether Duupa has word stress and where it falls.
